label: tab:db_comparison
description: MARINA-DB vs SPECTRE-DB spectral/molecule counts (main) + MARINA-DB-PRIVATE vs MARINA-DB (supplement); development datasets MARINA-DB-PARTIAL vs MARINA-DB-PRIVATE vs MARINA-DB (counts only, no experimental rows)

inputs.MARINA-DB: Datasets/MARINA-DB-OPEN-OLD (= the 2026-09-29 build the committed table was generated from; renamed from MARINA-DB-OPEN 2026-10-15; zip sha256 2780459f70eb732d7c374939bf607035a490eedcaacd2dc17cbfcc015fed9eee). Release build = Datasets/MARINA-DB (49442996...): regeneration on it is the paper session's call
inputs.SPECTRE-DB: constants from the SPECTRE paper (no local artifact)
inputs.MARINA-DB-PARTIAL: Datasets/MARINA1 (the MARINA1-era dataset; no negative-mode MS/MS, so that count is 0)

how: python paper/db_comparison/gen_db_comparison.py (counts = molecules with each has_* flag; experimental = nmr_sources.parquet source 'chnmr')
